evidence.detail: Iter1 F-1 is resolved. docs/spec/60.workflow-release.srs.md:15706 (FR-FLOW-226 AC-1) now has the run call update_roadmap_item at run start, only when get_roadmap_item reports Actual Start '-', setting only Actual Start with a reason naming run_id, and calls sync_roadmap_actuals(apply, item) only at run end. This no longer depends on the computed status at run start. Checked against FR-NODE-256 AC-4 (reason required for an Actual Start change -> reason supplied), FR-NODE-256 AC-3 (one history row), IR-CLI-115 AC-4 / IR-MCP-009 AC-1 (update takes --actual-start), FR-NODE-257 AC-3 (the run-end sync leaves the filled Actual Start alone) and FR-PARSE-046 AC-3 (Actual Start is YYYY-MM-DD). The requirement statement (:15693) and AC-2 (:15707, the single run-start update) match AC-1.

findings.description: The run-start timing defect is fixed: Actual Start is written by an explicit run-start update, not by a status-dependent sync.

evidence.detail: Requirements applied together do not produce the promised run-end recording. Reachable path: an item created by kiwi-roadmap with Targets '-' and Requirements '-' (FR-NODE-256 AC-1, docs/spec/50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:17181, writes '-' for an unset value; FR-FLOW-224 AC-4, docs/spec/60.workflow-release.srs.md:15581) is run as `/kiwi-wave-master PRD_PATH=<prd> ROADMAP_ITEM=RM-k` (or without PRD_PATH). (1) FR-FLOW-212 AC-1 (docs/spec/60.workflow-release.srs.md:14794, target 5.3.0) makes wave-master itself run kiwi-prd and `/kiwi-srs PRD_PATH=<prd> TARGET=<product target>`. (2) No requirement makes wave-master pass ROADMAP_ITEM to that kiwi-prd/kiwi-srs call (grep 'ROADMAP_ITEM' docs/spec/*.srs.md finds only FR-FLOW-224/225/226, and FR-FLOW-226 has no forwarding clause), so by FR-FLOW-225 AC-3 (:15646) kiwi-srs calls no roadmap tool and the product target is not added to the item's Targets. (3) FR-FLOW-226 AC-2 (:15707) forbids wave-master any update_roadmap_item other than the run-start Actual Start call, so it cannot add the target itself. (4) At run end R and T are still empty, so FR-NODE-255 AC-2 (docs/spec/50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:17106) computes `idea` (its idea branch precedes both done and the Actual-Start in-progress branch) even after every requirement is verified, and FR-NODE-257 AC-1 (:17254) proposes no Actual End. Result: the run that FR-FLOW-226's title and statement (:15693) say records the end date leaves Actual End '-', and the item reads idea with null progress while its Actual Start is set. The Research note's stated limit (unfinished requirements leave Actual End empty) does not cover this: here the requirements are finished but outside the item's scope.

findings.description: When wave-master is given an item that names no target or requirement, the product target it authors is never linked to the item (no ROADMAP_ITEM forwarding, and AC-2 forbids its own update), so at run end the item computes as idea and sync never records Actual End.
findings.suggested_action: Close the hop in one place: have FR-FLOW-226 pass ROADMAP_ITEM on to the kiwi-prd and kiwi-srs calls it makes (so FR-FLOW-225 AC-2 links the target), or let its run-start update also set Targets when the product target is known, or stop when the given item has empty R and T at run start; state the chosen behaviour in an AC.

evidence.detail: Same as iter1 D-1: FR-FLOW-226 AC-1 calls sync_roadmap_actuals with apply and item and no reason; whether FR-NODE-257 AC-4's 'same ... history-row rules as update' imports FR-NODE-256 AC-4's refusal without a reason depends on reading (IR-CLI-115 AC-4 gives sync a --reason option). No contradiction proven.

findings.description: Possible missing reason on the run-end sync call.

5.3.0 goal; IR-CLI-115 output carries stable IDs, dates and progress, consistent.

Skill (FR-FLOW-224); structure with planned start/end and computed completion status (FR-PARSE-046 AC-2/3, FR-NODE-255); record through tools (FR-NODE-256, IR-CLI-115 AC-4, IR-MCP-009); read through tools (IR-CLI-115 AC-1/2, IR-MCP-009). 'json 파일 형식' taken as the --json output contract per PRD-27 (IR-CLI-115 AC-6).
docs/roadmap.md is structured Markdown with ### RM-<n> headings, Field|Value tables and fixed sections; JSON is output only.

Every adopted point is present and none reversed: target 5.4.0 after 5.3.0; single source docs/roadmap.md (FR-PARSE-046); json = --json contract schema 1, no JSON source (IR-CLI-115 Req/AC-6); status computed (FR-NODE-255), only paused/cancelled by hand via Lifecycle, Status row forbidden (FR-PARSE-046 AC-2/AC-7, FR-PARSE-047 AC-3); coarse YYYY-MM / YYYY-Qn (FR-PARSE-046 AC-3); rules in an SRS-MD appendix (FR-PARSE-047); actual dates recorded by wave-master (FR-FLOW-226: explicit run-start Actual Start, run-end sync; FR-NODE-257); tools list|show|check|add|update|sync (IR-CLI-115); skill kiwi-roadmap (FR-FLOW-224). The unlinked-item path where the end date is never recorded is finding F-2, a combination defect, not a reversal of the PRD.

Tool-gap part: planned-target registration (IR-CLI-116), list_targets MCP pair (IR-MCP-010), rename-target roadmap references (FR-NODE-258), all in 5.4.0 (after 5.3.0, not 5.2.0). The other parts (Covers range ban, PRD citation form, kiwi-prd splitting) are 5.3.0 and not contradicted.
Exclusion: no requirement builds a dashboard; IR-CLI-115 Rationale keeps the exclusion and only exposes stable IDs, dates and progress.
